title: Held-out: normal operation, 5 April 2020
notes: H6 held-out negative (docs/plan/heldout-seal.md): a normal day drawn by the rule committed before the draw, from the days no scenario, slice, tuning case or document had used, 48 h or more from every labelled failure and unlabelled episode, with no known anomaly or gap. The expectation is that of the existing normal days (baseline_feb03_normal, summer_normal_jul05). Split heldout, profile heldout only: every other profile, --scenario and the tuning list refuse it, and only the set's one final run replays it, after the Jev thresholds are fixed under the pre-registration. H6 was decided after the E3 and E4 results had been seen, so every earlier figure stays in-sample.
